@everyone 🕯️🇹🇷 MOURNING AND CONDOLENCE ANNOUNCEMENT

Dear ZET Family,

We are deeply saddened by the news of the military helicopter crash involving a S-70 military helicopter, which claimed the lives of 4 brave Turkish soldiers today.

We pray for the souls of our fallen soldiers and extend our deepest condolences to their families, loved ones, and the entire Turkish nation.

As the ZET Family, we stand together in mourning and honor their memory.

We will never forget them.

🕯️🇹🇷 May they rest in peace.
